documentation.description: Current motion information from a designated system

record_types.name: Follow_Target

fields.name: Est_Capabilities
fields.description: Bitmask indicating which fields in this message contain valid data.

fields.name: Vel
fields.description:
Units: [m/s]
Target velocity in MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_NED frame. (0,0,0) for unknown.

fields.name: Acc
fields.description:
Units: [m/s/s]
Target linear acceleration in MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_NED frame. (0,0,0) for
unknown.

fields.name: Attitude_Q
fields.description:
Target orientation as a quaternion rotating from MAV_FRAME_BODY_FRD
to MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_NED (w, x, y, z order, zero-rotation is [1, 0, 0,
0]). (0, 0, 0, 0) for unknown.

fields.name: Rates
fields.description:
Units: [rad/s]
Target angular rates (roll, pitch, yaw) in MAV_FRAME_BODY_FRD frame.
(0,0,0) for unknown.

fields.name: Custom_State
fields.description: button states or switches of a tracker device
